unverifiable_exemptions: Leases, rentals, occupancies or tenancies of 100 days or less for a vacation or recreational purpose (subsection 9)
coverage.summary: Applies statewide to lessors of residential real property, under both leases and tenancies at will, with no unit-count, construction-date or owner-occupancy limits. Vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less are excluded.
coverage.other_conditions: Does not apply to vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less (subsection 9).

result.notes: Set requires_unknown_facts to false. The section covers ordinary residential tenancies and has no building-class restriction. Added the subsection (9) vacation/recreational exclusion to unverifiable_exemptions, because assessor data cannot tell the purpose or duration of a tenancy; it is also kept in other_conditions. The source sets no unit-count, construction-date or owner-occupancy limits, so those fields stay null. The summary was reworded to track the statutory phrases 'residential real property', 'tenancy-at-will' and 'written lease agreement'.
